Do not change task facts or include experiment-condition labels. Return ONLY JSON {"task":"the task you took in the completed round","note":"handoff of at most 2000 characters"}."

We are agent A. In the completed round, A took T3, B took T2, C took T4, D took T1. The assigned joint allocation was {"A":"T3","B":"T2"}. So we need to output JSON with task: "T3" (the task A took) and note: a handoff note describing the completed allocation and the convention for next round, preserving the assigned allocation convention. Should be short, within 2000 characters. No extra text.

Thus output:

{
  "task":"T3",
  "note":"The previous round completed with A on T3 and B on T2 (C on T4, D on T1). The joint allocation convention is that A takes T3 and B takes T2. In the fresh round all tasks are unclaimed; follow the same convention: A should choose T3 and B should choose T2. Preserve this allocation pattern for your successor."
}

Make sure JSON only.
